label: TERRAFIELD ATLAS
narration: TerraField Atlas — NASA Earth intelligence for agricultural resilience, built for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. This is the end-to-end tour.

label: MISSION OVERVIEW · GUIDED TOUR
narration: The mission overview briefs the operator, and a guided seventeen-step tour walks new users through every module — automatically on first run.

label: EARTH INTELLIGENCE · HONEST TRENDS
narration: Earth Intelligence ingests the real NASA POWER record and tests it with seasonal Mann-Kendall statistics and multiple-testing control. Missing days are reported as missing — never imputed.

label: FIRE INTELLIGENCE · LIVE SOURCE SIGNS
narration: Fire Intelligence decodes the VIIRS thermal anomaly stream — the same detections NASA FIRMS distributes. Live probes show which upstreams answer right now: the detection stream is live; the FIRMS API host is blocked here — flagged, never faked. NASA EONET adds live wildfire events.

label: FIRE CALENDAR · DETECTION LEDGER
narration: Detections land in a queryable ledger with a fire calendar, confidence classes, and radiative power. Archive gaps are reported as no-data — never zero-filled.

label: FIRE WATCHLISTS · SCHEDULED RUN
narration: Regional watchlists define a geography and a threshold rule. This Zambia list runs on a six-hour cadence: the scheduler claimed it atomically, evaluated the real GIBS stream, and recorded a scheduled run — while backtest mode replays the same rule on any historical date.

label: PUSH DIGEST · SSE CHANNEL
narration: Every run pushes a cadence-aware digest over Server-Sent Events — the push chip counts it live. The digest window derives from the cadence itself, and the same payload exits through a signed webhook.

label: SYSTEM HEALTH · CRITICAL INFRASTRUCTURE
narration: System Health is the operational truth: liveness and readiness probes, a scheduler watchdog, circuit breakers, and per-provider latency — one hundred twenty requests logged, success and failure, nothing hidden.

label: EVIDENCE & PROVENANCE
narration: Every number is traceable: the evidence ledger records each request — status, latency, and correlation I D — so any claim audits back to its exact retrieval.

label: REAL DATA · HONEST GAPS · PUSH-DELIVERED INTELLIGENCE
narration: Webhooks are signed with timestamped H MAC signatures under O W A S P guidance — replay protection and SSRF guards included. TerraField Atlas: real data, honest gaps, push-delivered intelligence.
